title: Image Compressor · 100% Local, Privacy First
footer: All images are compressed locally in your browser — nothing is sent to any server. Works offline too.
footerDesc: Image Compressor — a privacy-first online image compression tool. All processing happens locally in your browser. No images are uploaded to any server.
seoH1: Free Online Image Compressor — 100% Local, Privacy First
seoDesc: Image Compressor is a free image compression tool that runs entirely in your browser. No files uploaded to any server, no sign-up required, no watermarks. Supports JPG, PNG, WebP, and AVIF compression and conversion, with automatic target-size compression (200KB/100KB/50KB), batch processing, and ZIP export.
feature1: 100% Private — All processing happens locally in your browser
feature2: Target Size — Set exact size (200KB/100KB/50KB), auto-adjusts quality
feature3: Multi-format — JPG / PNG / WebP / AVIF compression & conversion
feature4: Batch & ZIP — Upload multiple files, compress all, export as ZIP
feature6: No Watermark — Output is completely clean, no branding
usecase1: Email Attachments — Compress photos under 200KB for reliable delivery
usecase2: Web Optimization — Reduce image sizes to improve Core Web Vitals scores
usecase3: Job Applications — Fit headshots and documents into 200KB/100KB limits
usecase4: E-commerce — Batch compress product images for Shopify, Amazon, etc.
